method: Packed public ESM exports loaded into an existing production WebGPU application using a temporary bootstrap around its own animation callbacks. Application source and assets were read-only.

gpuDevices.deviceString: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M3 Max, Version 26.5.2 (Build 25F84))

limits: Browser smoke test using a temporary integration, not a committed host integration or full gameplay test.
CPU frame collection, panel capture, viewer loading and cleanup were checked; no GPU adapter was added to the external host.
Private application assets, source, server setup and raw recordings are excluded from this repository.
